# asc_vm_group (Resource)

Manages a virtual machine group through ASC .

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_vm_group" "example" {
  name   = "example-group"
  sku_id = "gp-2"
  vpc_id = asc_vpc.example.id
  image  = "ubuntu-24.04"

  autoscaling = {
    min_replicas = 2
    max_replicas = 10

    cron = {
      timezone         = "Europe/Amsterdam"
      start            = "0 8 * * 1-5"
      end              = "0 18 * * 1-5"
      desired_replicas = 6
    }
  }

  tags = {
    env = "production"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `autoscaling` (Attributes) Scaling bounds of the group. ASC has no update route for a group's policy, so any change replaces the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `name` (String)
- `sku_id` (String)
- `vpc_id` (String)

### Optional

- `customization` (Attributes, Sensitive) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customization))
- `image` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `attached_volumes` (List of String) Names of the volumes attached to the group, sorted
- `last_error` (String)
- `sku` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `status` (String)
- `urn` (String)
